# Parental Leave Policy

All employees who become parents, by birth, adoption or surrogacy, are eligible for parental leave.

## Duration

Parental leave is 20 weeks at full pay.

## Flexibility

Leave can be taken in up to 3 separate blocks, all within 18 months of the child's arrival.

## Returning

Employees can return on a reduced schedule of four days a week for the first month back, at full pay.
